WITH due AS (
 SELECT r.id,r.email,c.debut,
 CASE WHEN c.debut BETWEEN now()+interval '6 days 23 hours' AND now()+interval '7 days 1 hour' THEN 'RAPPEL_J7'
      WHEN c.debut BETWEEN now()+interval '23 hours' AND now()+interval '25 hours' THEN 'RAPPEL_J1'
      WHEN c.debut BETWEEN now()+interval '1 hour 45 minutes' AND now()+interval '2 hours 15 minutes' THEN 'RAPPEL_H2' END AS type
 FROM rendez_vous r JOIN creneaux c ON c.id=r.creneau_id
 WHERE r.statut IN ('CONFIRME','REPLANIFIE') AND r.email IS NOT NULL
), ins AS (
 INSERT INTO notifications(rendez_vous_id,type,canal,destinataire,statut)
 SELECT id,type,'EMAIL',email,'A_ENVOYER' FROM due WHERE type IS NOT NULL
 ON CONFLICT (rendez_vous_id,type,canal) DO NOTHING RETURNING *
) SELECT * FROM ins ORDER BY created_at;

SELECT
    n.id AS notification_id,
    n.type,
    n.destinataire,
    n.statut,

    r.id AS rendez_vous_id,
    r.reference,
    r.nom,
    r.prenom,
    r.email,
    r.telephone,
    r.token_gestion,

    c.debut,
    c.fin,

    s.code AS service,
    s.nom AS service_nom,

    si.code AS site,
    si.nom AS site_nom

FROM notifications n

JOIN rendez_vous r
    ON r.id = n.rendez_vous_id

JOIN creneaux c
    ON c.id = r.creneau_id

JOIN services s
    ON s.id = c.service_id

JOIN sites si
    ON si.id = c.site_id

WHERE n.statut = 'A_ENVOYER'
  AND n.canal = 'EMAIL'
  AND n.type IN (
      'RAPPEL_J7',
      'RAPPEL_J1',
      'RAPPEL_H2'
  )

ORDER BY
    n.created_at ASC;

UPDATE notifications
SET
    statut = 'ENVOYE',
    sent_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $1::uuid
RETURNING
    id,
    rendez_vous_id,
    type,
    canal,
    destinataire,
    statut,
    sent_at;
